game.title: Darksiders II
game.blurb: Third-person action RPG in which Death, the second Rider of the Apocalypse, sets out to support War, the hero of the first game, from Vigil Games, released 2012-08-14. RAWG average playtime: 5 hours. Genres: Action, RPG. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: Death's quest through the world, its dungeons and its bosses. Spoiler-guarded; most achievements here are hidden.

chapters.title: Finishing the Game and Difficulty
chapters.summary: Finishing on any setting, on Normal, on Apocalyptic and on Deathinitive.

chapters.title: Side Quests, Tombs and the Crucible
chapters.summary: Secondary quests, Death Tombs, Wicked K and The Crucible.

chapters.title: Gear, Levels and Abilities
chapters.summary: Elite gear, possessed weapons, Reaper Form, combat moves and reaching level 30.

attribution: Achievement data from Steam (Steam Web API, app 388410)
StrategyWiki: no usable walkthrough, nothing used — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/Darksiders_II
Fandom (darksiders.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://darksiders.fandom.com/wiki/Darksiders_II
notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). The Steam app used is Darksiders II Deathinitive Edition (388410), the only Darksiders II app in the Steam store list; its schema gives no game name. StrategyWiki has a page at completion stage 0; its Walkthrough is linked but not written, and the only subpages are "Controls" and a short "Table of Contents". darksiders.fandom.com answers the API, with about 122 linked pages, including "Darksiders II: Argul's Tomb", "Darksiders II: The Abyssal Forge" and "Darksiders II: The Demon Lord Belial"; names only were looked at, nothing copied. 36 of 50 Steam achievements are hidden, with no descriptions, so the main story chapter holds them all as a placeholder; some names (for example "The Lord of Bones", "City of the Dead", "Lord of the Black Stone", "Antiquing", "Respec Yourself") may be side content or add-on content, but nothing in the data says which. Only 4 chapters, because the visible achievements cover few themes. RAWG lists a playtime of only 5 hours, which looks low.
